doc.title: Richard Wyands interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002

title: Etta Jones's final session
summary: He played on her first hit and her final record, the Billie Holiday tribute.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: I know she was still singing it in the latter part of her career too.
Well I saw her, in fact I was on her final recording session.
Or whatever it’s called, “Lady Day.” Yeah. That was a pretty good record. Have you heard any of it?
She was singing very well. She loved to sing. So I think that I was on her first hit — it wasn’t her first record but the first hit — and then her last.
